title: MILESTONE SCIENTIFIC INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Milestone Scientific Inc. (MLSS), a micro-cap company listed on NYSE American, closed a private placement on April 20, 2026, raising $2.15 million gross through the issuance of 7,962,963 units at $0.27 per unit, with each unit consisting of one share of common stock and one warrant exercisable at $0.3375. Certain directors participated by purchasing $150,000 in units for cash and converting $351,000 in Convertible Bridge Notes into units. The company intends to use proceeds for working capital and paying past-due accounts payable.
key_points: Private placement of 7,962,963 units at $0.27/unit closed April 20, 2026; each unit = 1 common share + 1 warrant
Warrants have exercise price of $0.3375 (125% of unit price) and are exercisable for cash only for three years
Gross proceeds: $2,150,000 ($1,799,000 cash + $351,000 conversion of Convertible Bridge Notes)
Potential additional proceeds of up to $2,687,500 if all warrants are fully exercised
Directors/officers participated, purchasing $150,000 for cash and converting $351,000 in bridge notes
12-month lock-up agreements apply to directors, officers, and stockholders; registration rights for resale granted
